text: Forty dollars a month for a note-taking app is absurd when the free tier caps you at three documents.
Pricing is way too expensive for what you get. The free plan is basically a demo.
Search takes eight or nine seconds on a workspace with 4000 docs. It used to be instant.
The new editor is a huge improvement. Slash commands finally work the way I expect.
App is slow to load in the morning, maybe a cold start thing. Otherwise fine.
Too expensive. Competitors give you unlimited docs for half the price.
Sync stalled overnight and two of our editors saw stale content for most of the morning.
The new editor removed the outline panel I used constantly. Please bring it back.
Would happily pay if the pricing were reasonable, but this is priced for companies not people.
Mobile app crashes when I open a doc with a large table. Desktop is fine.
Genuinely the best writing tool I have used. The editor rewrite was worth the wait.
The price jump between free and pro is too steep. Give us something in between.
Performance degrades badly once a page has more than about 200 blocks. Typing lags behind.
Expensive and the free tier is useless. Uninstalled.
Support took six days to answer a billing question. That is a long time for an enterprise contract.
Editor is much nicer now. Still miss the old keyboard shortcut for callouts.
Sync conflicts keep creating duplicate pages when two people edit at once.
Pricing feels predatory. Three documents free then a paywall.
Mobile is clearly an afterthought. Half the formatting options are missing.
Way too expensive for a hobbyist. Shame, because the product is good.
Search is slow and often misses documents I know exist.
I do not like the new editor. It changed muscle memory I built over two years.
Onboarding for new team members is confusing. Nobody can find the permissions settings.
Cost is the only thing stopping me. Everything else is excellent.
The mobile app logs me out every few days and I have to sign in again.
The editor rewrite is excellent. Tables finally behave.
Onboarding docs are thin. We ended up writing our own internal guide.
Pricing is out of touch. Not worth it.
Everything is sluggish since the last update. Page loads take several seconds.
Still too expensive. The middle tier they promised never appeared.
A sync failure deleted three weeks of edits on our operations handbook. We have no way to recover them.
Two documents came back empty after a sync error. The content is gone and version history does not go back far enough.
Love the editor. Wish search were faster but I can live with it.
SSO login fails with an invalid assertion error for about a third of our staff since Monday.
We lost an entire project database. It vanished after a failed sync and support cannot restore it.
We cannot log in via Okta. SAML response is rejected. This is blocking 40 people.
Single sign-on stopped working after your release. Users are locked out.
The price is the problem. Everything else about it is fine.
SSO is still broken for our finance team. Third day of people unable to sign in.
Mobile app still cannot do tables properly. I only use it for reading.
Search performance is unusable on large workspaces. Ten seconds or more.
SAML login broken again this morning. We had to fall back to password auth for everyone.
Editor changes broke my workflow. The old outline panel needs to come back.
Slow. Noticeably slower than six months ago on the same hardware.
Too expensive for individuals. Please add a cheaper personal plan.
Single sign-on failing intermittently. About a quarter of login attempts are rejected.
Sync is unreliable on flaky connections. Changes sometimes do not propagate for an hour.
Support response times have got worse. Five days for a P2 ticket.
The new editor is fantastic. Best update in years.
SSO configuration page throws a 500 error. We cannot even reconfigure it.
Pricing. That is the whole review. It is too expensive.
Onboarding new starters takes too long because permissions are hard to understand.
Mobile app crashed three times today while scrolling a long document.
Editor is great now. Genuinely enjoyable to write in.
Okta SSO rejected again. Our IT team has spent a week on this.
Page load performance is poor. Several seconds every navigation.
Overall happy. Reliability has been the one sore point this quarter.
Expensive. I want to like it but the cost is hard to justify.
Sync stopped working entirely for one user until they cleared local data.
No complaints. Does exactly what I need and stays out of the way.
Fine. Nothing to add really.
The editor loses cursor position when a collaborator types above you.
Good product. The account manager has been responsive.
